name: inflow-mcp
description: Let Claude work with your inflow LinkedIn network — search connections, read network stats, and draft messages into your Outbox. Claude reads and drafts only; it never sends.

pairing_code.title: inflow pairing code
pairing_code.description: Copy it from inflow → MCP connector → Connect Claude.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Only needed for inflow's in-app Claude agent. The key stays here in the companion and is never sent to the browser. Leave blank if you don't use the in-app agent.
